no_execute_instruction: These command arrays are review data, not permission or a runnable controller.

default and pinned state match preflight
no loading or active/waiting requests at completion
not_claimed: successful completion of every SSD cache write before exit

approval_needed: accept cold restart and explicitly bounded persisted-visible recovery rather than original-PID suspend/resume
accept loss of in-flight/warm memory state and possible incomplete SSD cache flush
authorize exact three review-only actions plus bounded read-only verification
remaining_unknowns: current service identity/residency must be refreshed just before mutation
full old transient runtime variant is not exposed
resident-mode reload can be rejected or forced SSD by changed physical memory
GLM initialization peak remains independently unqualified
failure_policy: No GLM while pressure is elevated or service removal/reclaim is unproven. Reap experiment before recovery. Any unexpected loaded set, PID/port owner, config drift, POST unknown outcome or SSD PLE produces recovery-incomplete, never silent success.
